verdict.rationale: Bento documents broadcasts as one-time marketing sends to a broad audience or a saved segment. Its API can create campaigns and schedule approved sends with explicit audience rules, including tag exclusions, and segments and drag-and-drop templates support targeting and composition. However, the evidence is mostly API- and CLI-focused and does not clearly document a marketer-facing compose-to-send flow or an immediate 'send now' option. missing for 10: explicit in-app broadcast composer documentation, documented immediate send (as opposed to scheduled), independent or hands-on corroboration of the campaign-sending loop.

support.subject: As a marketer, I can compose an email campaign, pick its audience, and send or schedule it — the arena's table-stakes loop
